question: For each building type, list the name of the building type, the number of buildings that are not subdivisions, number of employees, number of unique building street address, number of unique city, number of unique state, number of unique postal code, and average gross square footage per employee. For building type of 'resident', display it as 'RESIDENTIAL'. Include a grand total across all building types (the corresponding type field is 'TOTAL').

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    fb.BUILDING_TYPE,
    fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA,
    a.FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY,
    a.CITY,
    a.STATE,
    a.POSTAL_CODE,
    a.STREET_NUMBER,
    a.STREET_NAME,
    e.MIT_ID
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
    ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
   AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
    ON r.BUILDING_ROOM = e.OFFICE_LOCATION
),
by_type AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL' ELSE BUILDING_TYPE END AS building_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL THEN FCLT_BUILDING_KEY END) AS non_subdivision_buildings,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MIT_ID) AS employees,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL OR STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY END) AS unique_street_address,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CITY) AS unique_city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT STATE) AS unique_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT POSTAL_CODE) AS unique_postal_code,
    SUM(EXT_GROSS_AREA) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT MIT_ID), 0) AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
  FROM base
  GROUP BY BUILDING_TYPE
),
total AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS building_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL THEN FCLT_BUILDING_KEY END) AS non_subdivision_buildings,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MIT_ID) AS employees,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL OR STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY END) AS unique_street_address,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CITY) AS unique_city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT STATE) AS unique_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT POSTAL_CODE) AS unique_postal_code,
    SUM(EXT_GROSS_AREA) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT MIT_ID), 0) AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
  FROM base
)
SELECT * FROM by_type
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM total
ORDER BY CASE WHEN building_type = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, building_type
